summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0, authored/generated Levels 1–3 and M.E.G. Base Gamma. Ordered player behaviors own personal survival and progression; place simulations build local spaces and actors, while shared maze, breakable and loot helpers connect local geometry and gameplay. First-person weapon presentation uses fitted mesh grips for melee variants.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's generated yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded hash-positioned moments and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, camp agents, searchable loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and swept props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold; grid walls and swept props are destructible.

places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze zones/crawl halls, lamps, Gamma fortress checkpoint, hazards, lore props, loot, hound brigades and deathmoth swarms; destructible grid walls/props and Level 3 blackouts.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards and residents; x0z0.scene places authored gamma-light points, and a door returns to Level 3.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, actions (including Caps Lock walk and Ctrl/Z crouch), player template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry and presented yaw/pitch with crouched eye height.
places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js, places/gamma/sim.js, places/debug/sim.js - local setup and simulation tick roots.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; main, level1 and debug have authored cell sets; Gamma has an authored light scene.
scripts/ui.js with loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js, craft-ui.js, horde-ui.js and noclip-ui.js - HUD composition and action routing.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim and creatures.
scripts/lib/level0-moments.js + scripts/moments-geo.js + scripts/moments.js - deterministic Level 0 oddity placement, shared prop geometry and interactive/sound behavior.
scripts/lib/furniture.js + scripts/lib/data/furniture-loot.yml - searchable container placement and loot factory shared by Level 0, 1 and 3; Level 2 has its own path.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js, weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js and weapon-geo.js - weapon definitions and fitted variants shared by pickups, viewmodels and NPCs; weapon-look maps melee mesh grip poses.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/loot3.js - shared token vocabulary and general loot, with Level 3-specific tables and drops.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js - apparel/armor and HALOGEN derivations reused by player, NPC combat, loot and UI.

scripts/lib/wallgrid.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - Level 1/2/3 wall-grid damage and mesh sync plus Level 0 wall damage; sweeps live-box, l2box and container props into breakables.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/gamma/sim.js also exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - wallPose, layMoments; scripts/moments.js - ears, update; scripts/moments-geo.js - geometry, collider, PILLARS, FALSEDOOR_COLLIDER.
scripts/lib/gamma-exterior.js - GATE, layGammaExterior; scripts/gamma-fortress-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/l3-lamp-geo.js - geometry.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - HEAD_ID, GAIT_LIB, speciesOf, bodyModel, headModel, faceMorph, critterSpec; data is in scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml.

scripts/lib/furniture.js - sizeOf, pickKind, spawnFurniture and wallSpot0/1/3; scripts/lib/breakables.js - strike/damage/drop/rubble, sweepProps, Level 0 sync and gridWallAt/syncWalls/tickWalls; weapon-look.js - MESHGRIP, HOLD, weaponBody.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi; scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update.
scripts/smilers.js - MODEL, SCALE, update; scripts/lurkers.js - LURKER_MODEL, LURKER_SCALE, update; scripts/horde.js - update; scripts/horde-ui.js - hordeUi.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/sanity, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass and Level 3 consumable/page fields.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state hunger/thirst, craftOpen/craftBench and needs drain; starvation reduces hp but floors it at 1; scrap and recipes are consumed/validated here.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries the owning player's horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.
scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu, notices and interaction; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state, containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state.
scripts/talk.js and scripts/critter.js - dialogue state is split across player/NPC; player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots and avatar scratch is local/session state.

Place simulations - place.state owns seed/version flags, local schedules, Level 3 blackout/flicker and broken/wallHp keys; session.wallTick gates wall regrowth ticks; main owns momentsV and almondTidy, Level 3 owns gammaExtV/roundsV.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: locomotion reads prior movement; player owns movement/survival/combat; interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft and horde handle their ordered actions before critter behavior.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and crouched eye height; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; thresholds connect Level 1 to 2 and Level 2 to 3; Gamma door in places/gamma/sim.js returns to the Level 3 fortress gate.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js sends typed text/actions through talk/talkdo/shop inputs to talk.js; talk.js submits llm:chat and heard validates replies/checks before rapport changes.

talk.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle → talk-ui.js / ui.js; nearby NPC voice is emitted; shop actions update almond water, inventory and NPC stock; Level 3 Gamma agents use chatter data for nearby conversations.
interact.js E → door/container/bench or usable-specific press event; bench opens crafting; usable entities receive press and own their response.

scripts/craft.js drains player hunger/thirst and handles craft inputs → scripts/craft-ui.js renders needs/menu; recipes and costs come from scripts/lib/data/craft.yml, with recipeStatus in scripts/lib/craft.js.

scripts/horde.js countdown/waves → player horde state and horde-ui.js; horde.yml places currently restrict blackouts to Level 3; tagged smilers/lurkers/hounds read creature state.horde and hunt that player.
Level 3 players' horde === night → places/level3/sim.js sets place.state.blackout/flicker, saves lamp light in lamp state and dims lit l3lamp objects red; ending the night restores saved light.
Place simulations and enemy deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js or loot3.js → weapon/clothing/item tokens or containers; main/level1/level3 seed searchable furniture through scripts/lib/furniture.js.

player.js attack → scripts/lib/breakables.js: Level 0 wall/voxel or Level 1–3 grid wall/entity hp and broken keys → wall mesh cut plus scripts/wallpatch-geo.js remnants; tickWalls regrows cleared sections when the gap is unoccupied.

scripts/player.js local first-person viewmodel → weapon-look.js weaponBody and MESHGRIP pose (unless vmTune overrides) → fitted melee mesh sits at the fist grip; unlisted weapons use the generic hold transform.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; use uploaded Tripo rigged meshes, with horde hunt hooks.

scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js - shared Level 1/2/3 hound AI with rigged hound-v2 mesh; safe zones and grids vary by place, Level 3 brigades use maze routing and stun state; blackout nights raise their dark hunt pressure.
scripts/stealers.js + stealer-geo.js - Level 1 skin-stealer behavior swaps legacy rows to rigged mesh; disguise/creature/shed parts and reveal animation vary by hunt phase.

scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/critter2-geo.js - common NPC avatar and behavior varies by species/look, role, voice, weapon and place; used by M.E.G., Survivors and Gamma agents, with optional patrol/work rounds at Level 3.

scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js, weapon-geo.js and viewmodel-geo.js - weapon kinds reuse fitted bodies with variant stats/tint/overlays and viewmodel framing; melee Tripo meshes have per-kind grip poses.

scripts/lib/furniture.js + loot-bags-geo.js + l2-props-geo.js - searchable containers share item/lock state and placement API, with kind-specific shape/material/loot tables; separate from breakable office furniture in main.
scripts/deathmoths.js + templates/deathmoths.js - one Level 3 manager steers multiple swarms; each uses rigged moth models and clips, while swarms vary by home and target.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m. Keep geometry, wallgrid, zones, exits and routes aligned.
Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js, craft.js, horde.js and critter.js; locomotion reads movement before player control writes velocity.

Weapon ids remain kind or kind~variant across inventory, condition, magazines and entities; viewmodel MESHGRIP is keyed by base weapon kind, while vmTune mat/mrot can override its grip position/rotation.

Building scrap is a per-kind player.state.scrap object, unlike comma-separated inventory/container tokens; breakables require tag plus state.mat/hp/maxHp. Grid wall damage stores per-voxel wallHp/broken timestamps and tickWalls regrows only when clear.

scripts/lib/breakables.js sweepProps assigns materials/hp to selected live-box, l2box and container props; keep its kind-to-material mapping aligned with breakables.yml. wallHp is one wall section: cinderblock/brick/tile now use 300/260/200 respectively.
